name: PurchaseOrder
description: A non-posting transaction representing a request to purchase goods or services from a third-party vendor.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: APAccountRef
fields.description: Specifies to which AP account the bill is credited. The account must have Classification set to Liability and AccountSubType set to AccountsPayable. Recommended to be explicitly specified in all cases.

fields.name: VendorRef
fields.description: Reference to the vendor for this transaction.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: Individual line items of a transaction. Valid Line types include: ItemBasedExpenseLine and AccountBasedExpenseLine.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: The Id of the line item.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line item.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: The type of line detail. e.g. ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail or AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.

attributes.name: ProjectRef
attributes.description: Reference to the project associated with the line.

attributes.name: ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail for an item-based expense line.

attributes.name: ItemRef
attributes.description: Reference to the item. Must reference an Item that has an expense account linked to it.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the customer associated with the line.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the tax code for the line.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: Billable status of the line. e.g. NotBillable, Billable, HasBeenBilled.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on the associated transaction are expressed. Conditionally required: must be defined if multicurrency is enabled for the company.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full name of the currency.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Method in which tax is applied. Not applicable to US companies; required for non-US companies.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date entered by the user when this transaction occurred. If not supplied, the current date on the server is used. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: One of, up to three custom fields for the transaction. Available for custom fields so configured for the company.

attributes.name: DefinitionId
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the custom field definition.

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the custom field.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The data type of the custom field. e.g. StringType.

fields.name: POEmail
fields.description: Used to specify the vendor e-mail address where the purchase req is sent.

fields.name: ClassRef
fields.description: Reference to the Class associated with the transaction. Available if ClassTrackingPerTxn is enabled.

fields.name: SalesTermRef
fields.description: Reference to the sales term associated with the transaction.

fields.name: LinkedTxn
fields.description: Zero or more Bill objects linked to this purchase order; LinkedTxn.TxnType is set to Bill.

attributes.name: TxnId
attributes.description: The Id of the linked transaction.

attributes.name: TxnType
attributes.description: The type of the linked transaction. e.g. Bill.

fields.name: Memo
fields.description: A message for the vendor. This text appears on the Purchase Order object sent to the vendor.

fields.name: POStatus
fields.description: Purchase order status.

fields.name: DueDate
fields.description: Date when the payment of the transaction is due. If not provided, the number of days specified in SalesTermRef added to the transaction date will be used.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. Set by Data Services and read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was last updated.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. If not explicitly provided, populated based on the VendorAndPurchasesPrefs.UseCustomTxnNumbers preference. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: User entered, organization-private note about the transaction. Does not appear on the purchase order to the vendor. Maps to the Memo field on the Purchase Order form.

fields.name: ShipMethodRef
fields.description: Reference to the user-defined ShipMethod associated with the transaction. Store shipping method string in both ShipMethodRef.value and ShipMethodRef.name.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Information for taxes charged on the transaction as a whole. Ignored and not stored if sales tax is disabled.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction tax code.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any embedded tax.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Tax detail lines for the transaction.

fields.name: ShipTo
fields.description: Reference to the customer to whose shipping address the order will be shipped to.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The number of home currency units it takes to equal one unit of currency specified by CurrencyRef. Applicable if multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: ShipAddr
fields.description: Address to which the vendor shipped or will ship any goods associated with the purchase.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, such as state or province.

fields.name: VendorAddr
fields.description: Address to which the payment should be sent.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, such as state or province.

fields.name: EmailStatus
fields.description: Email status of the purchase order.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: Indicates the total amount of the transaction, including all charges, allowances, and taxes. Calculated by QuickBooks; any value supplied is over-written.

fields.name: RecurDataRef
fields.description: A reference to the Recurring Transaction. Captures what recurring transaction template the PurchaseOrder was created from.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the recurring transaction template.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the recurring transaction template.

update.PrivateNote: This is a private note added during update.

specialOperations.name: Get a purchase order as PDF
specialOperations.description: Returns the specified purchase order in the response body as an Adobe PDF file formatted according to the company's custom form styles.

pathParams.name: purchaseorderId
pathParams.description: The Id of the purchase order to retrieve as PDF.

specialOperations.name: Send a purchase order
specialOperations.description: Emails the specified purchase order to the vendor, setting PurchaseOrder.EmailStatus to EmailSent.

queryParams.name: sendTo
queryParams.description: Explicit email address to send the purchase order to; if specified (and minor version >= 17), PurchaseOrder.POEmail.Address is updated to this value.

pathParams.name: purchaseorderId
pathParams.description: The Id of the purchase order to send.

specialOperations.note: Two variants: implicit (uses email in PurchaseOrder.POEmail.Address) via POST .../send, and explicit (POST .../send?sendTo=<emailAddr>). EmailStatus is set to EmailSent on success.
